Camera & comfort

Explore camera: drag to turn all around the streetcar, drag up or down to change height, and pinch or scroll to zoom. J / L turn, I / K change height, and + / - zoom. Re-centre restores the starting view.

Calm gently drifts around a steady view. The following views travel with the streetcar. Sidewalk stays at standing eye level and softly dissolves to a new spot after each pass. Explore lets you choose your own angle.

    Keyboard & switch controls

    Space or Enter activates Go when the street is focused. Tab moves between buttons. A focused button works with Space or Enter. B rings the bell; H sounds the horn; C changes the camera; Full driving also uses W / Up for power, S / Down for brake, Space for emergency brake, and D for doors.

    Use a switch configured to send Space, Enter, or a mouse click. Holding a key does not repeatedly depart stops.

    Headlights, side markers and cabin lights turn on after dusk. Brake lights work during the day too.

    Settings are remembered on this browser. This is a Queen Street–inspired setting, with compressed distances. The bell rings automatically when the streetcar starts moving after a stop.
